scripts.db:generate: bun run --cwd packages/db db:generate && bun db:migrate
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/web && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply omegastart-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: cd apps/web && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply omegastart-db --remote
scripts.ok: syncpack fix --log-levels error && vp run ts -r && vp fmt --write && vp lint --fix && vp run test -r
scripts.ok:ci: syncpack lint --log-levels error && vp run ts -r && vp fmt --check && vp lint && vp run test -r
